identity.name: Axolittles
identity.notes: Community/DAO-transitioned collection. The surviving Axoquarium Unity handoff includes directly downloadable FBX character models whose Unity importer metadata proves humanoid/avatar rigging. The broader avatar inventory is therefore partial rather than unknown, while exhaustive enumeration remains open.

evidence.note: Official Jan. 6, 2022 project handover post explicitly lists discord.gg/axolittlesnft.
Latest substantive official governance post lists https://twitter.com/AxolittlesNFT among project-managed social infrastructure.
OpenSea independently resolves the collection launch month to Sep 2021.
Contemporaneous NFT Calendar archive lists the Axolittles mint on September 6, 2021.

ip_rights.summary: The Jan. 26, 2023 transition proposal suggested CC BY, but the later Feb. 1, 2023 official governance handoff explicitly rescinded all prior IP-licensing statements and left licensing of the NFTs, Seasonal Axolittles, Axoquarium 3D models and code for the community to decide. No later controlling community license decision was recovered, so the catalog must not present CC BY as settled rights.

evidence.note: Jan. 26 proposal described a planned CC BY license.
Feb. 1 update supersedes prior statements: IP licensing, including 3D models, is entirely for the community to decide.

surviving_3d_assets.summary: The surviving public Axoquarium/Unity handoff contains Axolittles-specific FBX character assets. Recursive tree inspection found no .vrm or .glb paths. Importer metadata for inspected BaseModel FBXs includes skeletons, humanoid bone mappings and Unity avatar-generation settings, proving that at least part of the surviving FBX lane is rigged/avatar-ready rather than mesh-only. This does not prove that every FBX in the repository is rigged or that a native VRM release never existed historically.

evidence.note: The original team states that Axoquarium 3D models and code were included in the community handoff.
BaseModel tree contains directly stored FBX character assets including Adventurer.fbx and Angel.fbx with corresponding Unity .fbx.meta importer files.
Angel importer metadata maps joints to Hips, legs, feet, spine, chest, neck, head, shoulders, arms and hands and records animationType 3, avatarSetup 1 and automatic avatar mapping.
Adventurer importer metadata contains a populated skeleton hierarchy and records animationType 3, avatarSetup 1 and automatic avatar mapping.
GitHub Releases returned no release artifacts, so no release-packaged VRM or GLB evidence was recovered there.

avatar_formats.note: FBX now qualifies as a usable avatar format for Axolittles because inspected public handoff models carry explicit Unity humanoid/avatar rig metadata. This is stronger than extension-only format evidence and remains scoped to the inspected surviving assets.

evidence.note: HumanDescription contains explicit standard humanoid bone mappings; importer also records animationType 3 and avatarSetup 1.
Importer contains a substantial skeleton hierarchy and records animationType 3, avatarSetup 1 and automatic avatar mapping.

rigging_evidence.note: Matching Unity importer metadata contains a populated skeleton and avatar-generation settings.
Matching Unity importer metadata explicitly maps the skeleton to standard humanoid bones and records avatar-generation settings.

avatar_inventory.note: Two surviving public FBX avatars are now directly enumerable and evidence-backed as rigged. The BaseModel tree contains additional FBXs, so the lane stays partial until all qualifying FBXs are enumerated or a narrower exhaustive representation lane is established.

evidence.note: Repository tree establishes that additional BaseModel FBXs remain to be classified and enumerated.

project_status.note: Evidence-based lifecycle inference: the latest substantive official project publication recovered is the Feb. 1, 2023 community/DAO handoff. The official Medium profile and marketplace references remain reachable in 2026, but no later substantive official development update was recovered in this research pass. Dormant is used rather than sunset because the assets/governance were deliberately handed to the community and no shutdown announcement was found.
